budgetNotes.v3-foundation: The additive v3 preparation layer includes the shared controller registry, typed errors and agent envelopes, bounded configuration and storage, IndexedDB, governed AI/MCP transports, privacy-safe diagnostics, compatibility diagnostics, and security policy gates. The 2.4 compatibility bundle measures about 133.8 KB gzip; profile bundles and internal splitting are required before 3.0 stable.
